channel.title: TheGapBrief
channel.description: A weekly brief on product gaps, emerging markets, and AI updates.

item.title: Preview issue · October 6, 2026: Test run: Watermarks, ads, and the controls users lost
item.description: A short test issue: OpenAI watermarks ChatGPT text in the EU and adds image-side ads, ChatGPT users report lost controls, and seed money goes to likeness licensing, personal AI hardware, and robot safety.

item.title: Week 1 · October 5, 2026: Agents shipped this week. The controls around them did not.
item.description: Always-on agents arrived while permission scoping, spend caps, and agent attribution lag behind. Plus agent-identity funding, decision models, and OpenAI shelving GPT-6.1 Astra.
